+					return nil, &auth.MCPAuthError{Code: http.StatusForbidden, Message: "insufficient scopes", ScopesRequired: a.ScopesRequired}

+		tokenScopes := strings.Fields(tokenInfo.Scope)

+		for _, s := range tokenScopes {

+		}

+			}
+		}
